blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The EcoWaste Coalition has called for a government crackdown on unauthorized and counterfeit squishy toys, urging the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) to work with customs, police and local government units to stop their sale ahead of the Christmas shopping season. The environmental and health watchdog group said squishy toys lacking market authorization and proper labeling continue to be sold in informal markets, raising concerns about the possible presence of hazardous substances in some products. The call came after the FDA issued safety reminders on the purchase and proper use of squishy toys through Advisory No. 2026-1705, published […]...
